title: mercurialis perennis subsp. ovata
intro: Mercurialis perennis subsp. ovata, commonly known as the annual mercury or lesser perennating mercury, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Mercurialis perennis subsp. ovata involve stimulating the respiratory system, relieving coughs, and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
